newsitem.title: USA: Corp bond issuance fades, players set for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Corp bond issuance fades, players set for holiday.

text.p: The issuance of new corporate debt offerings is expected largely to fade on Thursday as players head out early during an abbreviated session before the Independence Day holiday, dealers said.

"We won't see much, if any, activity today despite the improved market tone," said one high grade syndicate source. "It's difficult to get anything done with so many players already out on holiday," he said.
Meanwhile, the tone in the market continued to improve following the U.S government's release of its June labor report which showed only fairly moderate growth in new jobs and wages.
